experiences.name: Schwarzwaldhochstrasse
experiences.description: The B500 ridge road from Baden-Baden to Freudenstadt, the classic first taste of the Black Forest. It climbs past the Mummelsee and Ruhestein over 1,000 m with long views across the Rhine plain and smooth, flowing bends.

experiences.name: Feldberg and Schauinsland
experiences.description: From Freiburg up the Schauinsland road, across to Todtnau and over the Feldberg pass, the highest ground in the Black Forest, before dropping to St. Blasien and its great dome. Tight, steep, scenic mountain bends from start to finish.

experiences.name: Kinzig Valley to Titisee
experiences.description: Out of Offenburg up the Kinzig valley to Triberg and its waterfalls, then over the high plateau through Furtwangen to Lake Titisee and on to Schluchsee. A varied run of valley sweepers, cuckoo-clock villages and forest climbs.

experiences.name: Black Forest Grand Tour
experiences.description: A full day from Baden-Baden to Lake Constance: the Hochstrasse over the Mummelsee, Freudenstadt, the Triberg area and Titisee, then out of the forest towards Konstanz. The whole Black Forest in one long, rewarding ride.

experiences.name: Upper Danube Gorge
experiences.description: Follow the young Danube from Tuttlingen through the rock-walled valley at Beuron to Sigmaringen castle, then on to the Blautopf spring at Blaubeuren and Ulm. Quiet roads, limestone cliffs and little traffic.

experiences.name: Swabian Alb Castle Run
experiences.description: Hohenzollern country to the edge of the Alb: Lichtenstein castle on its cliff, Bad Urach and the Hohenneuffen fortress, ending below the Teck. Short hairpin climbs up the Albtrauf and sweeping plateau roads in between.

sights.name: Unserer Lieben Frau und St. Nikolaus

experiences.name: Deutsche Alpenstrasse
experiences.description: The German Alpine Road end to end, from Lake Constance at Lindau to Berchtesgaden under the Watzmann. It strings together the Oberjoch pass, Garmisch, the Tegernsee and Ruhpolding: a long day with the whole Bavarian Alps on show.

experiences.name: Alpine Lakes Road
experiences.description: From Garmisch over the Kesselberg to Walchensee, then along the Tegernsee and over the Sudelfeld to Sachrang and down to the Chiemsee at Prien. Lakes, mountain passes and pastures with the Alps always ahead.

experiences.name: Steigerwald and Franconian Switzerland
experiences.description: Würzburg's vineyards to Bayreuth through the Steigerwald forest, Bamberg's hills and the limestone valleys of the Franconian Switzerland. Castle villages, beer gardens and endless medium-speed bends.

experiences.name: Romantic Road
experiences.description: Germany's most famous holiday route, from Würzburg to Füssen at the foot of the Alps. Walled Rothenburg, Nördlingen, Augsburg and Landsberg line the way, finishing near Neuschwanstein: an easy, relaxed day of old towns rather than hairpins.

sights.name: Pfarrkirche St. Johannes der Täufer zu Asch

experiences.name: Castle Road
experiences.description: The Burgenstrasse from Heidelberg to Nuremberg: down the Neckar past Hirschhorn, then Bad Wimpfen, Schwäbisch Hall and Rothenburg. A culture-heavy day of castles, half-timbered towns and quiet country roads.

experiences.name: Danube Road
experiences.description: Down the Danube from Ulm to Passau on the old river road: Donauwörth, Ingolstadt, Regensburg and Straubing. Mostly easy cruising through towns and farmland, with Regensburg's medieval centre as the highlight.

experiences.name: Harz Mountains
experiences.description: From the half-timbered old town of Goslar over the high Harz at Torfhaus to Wernigerode and Quedlinburg, then through the Selke valley to Stolberg. Forested climbs under the Brocken and some of the most charming old towns in Germany.

experiences.name: Eifel and the Ring
experiences.description: From Monschau's slate-roofed lanes through the high Eifel to Nürburg, home of the Nürburgring, and on to the Maria Laach volcanic lake. Open, fast and flowing country roads, popular with riders all year.

sights.name: Basilika St. Potentinus, Felicius und Simplicius

experiences.name: Moselle Wine Valley
experiences.description: Follow the Moselle from Roman Trier to the Deutsches Eck at Koblenz through the vineyard hairpin loops: Bernkastel-Kues, Zell and Cochem. Steep terraced slopes, castles and wine villages the whole way.

experiences.name: Rhine Castles
experiences.description: The Upper Middle Rhine gorge, a UNESCO World Heritage landscape, from Bingen to Koblenz along the B9. Bacharach, Sankt Goar and Boppard sit under a castle at nearly every bend: a short, sightseeing ride rather than a twisty one.

sights.name: Katholische Kirche St. Gordianus und Epimachus

experiences.name: Sauerland Highlands
experiences.description: Arnsberg to the Edersee through the Sauerland: Schmallenberg, the Kahler Asten and Winterberg, Willingen and on to Waldeck above the lake. The best-known riding area in western Germany, with endless curves through hills and forest.

experiences.name: Ore Mountains Crest
experiences.description: Dresden to Plauen via the Ore Mountains: Altenberg, the toy-making village of Seiffen, Oberwiesenthal at the foot of the Fichtelberg and Klingenthal. Little traffic, plenty of climbs and wooded valleys along the Czech border.

experiences.name: Elbe Castles to Saxon Switzerland
experiences.description: Up the Elbe from Meissen's cathedral hill through Dresden's old town, past Pillnitz palace, to Königstein fortress and Bad Schandau at the gateway to the sandstone rocks. A culture-rich, easy ride along the river.

experiences.name: Thuringian Forest
experiences.description: Eisenach and its Wartburg to Saalfeld along the high Thuringian Forest: Großer Inselsberg, Oberhof and Masserberg. Winding forest roads over the Rennsteig ridge with very little traffic.

experiences.name: Baltic Coast to Rügen
experiences.description: From Lübeck's Holstentor along the Baltic coast through Wismar, Rostock, the Fischland-Darß peninsula and Stralsund, then over the Rügen bridge to Cape Arkona. A long, flat day by the sea, with Hanseatic brick towns and beaches.

experiences.name: North Sea Dike Road
experiences.description: Niebüll to Brunsbüttel along the Schleswig-Holstein west coast, through Husum, Tönning and Büsum. Flat roads on top of and behind the dikes, big skies, sheep and wind turbines.

experiences.name: Spreewald Run
experiences.description: Out of Berlin to Cottbus through the Spreewald, a maze of canals, with Lübben, Lübbenau and Burg on the way. Flat, easy roads, alleys of old trees and plenty of places to stop for a gherkin and a boat trip.

sights.name: Slawenburg Raddusch - Słowjański gród w Radušu

experiences.name: Berlin to Potsdam Palaces
experiences.description: A short city-and-lakes ride from Alexanderplatz past the Siegessäule, through Wannsee and across the Glienicke Bridge to Sanssouci in Potsdam. Berlin landmarks, the Havel lakes and royal palaces in one easy morning.

sights.name: Der Mensch – Rhythmus will Wesen werden

experiences.name: Weser and Fairy Tale Road
experiences.description: Kassel to Bremen down the Weser: Bad Karlshafen, Höxter, Hameln of the Pied Piper and Minden, finishing at the Bremen town musicians. Gentle river-valley roads through half-timbered towns, more for relaxing than for hairpins.

sights.name: Koptisch-Othodoxes Kloster der heiligen Jungfrau Maria und des heiligen Mauritius
